delivery.notes: The verified PDF/EPUB source remains independently public. These private R2 objects are Hellbox Reader presentation assets used to prove protected Reader delivery; Hellbox does not claim the underlying SciVive source bytes are secret.

navigation.notes: Do not invent chapter page boundaries. Populate chapter anchors only after they are derived from the verified source content.

accessibility.notes: Generic page labels are a temporary facsimile baseline. Gate 2 cannot close until usable accessible text/navigation is derived from the source and the Reader is verified with keyboard and assistive-technology behavior.
